limits: Raw anonymous diarization, not ASR word attribution, speaker naming, meeting/live/device acceptance or a competitor-app ranking.

All IDs/models/settings fixed before test inference; the initial failed attempt inferred five clips before correcting a scorer boundary rejection. The unchanged full-WAV UEM crops beyond-audio RTTM tails; no extra forgiveness or excluded inputs.

Timing is serial separate passes with uncontrolled OS/Core ML caches/background and a separate pinned Qwen synthetic component soak. A small owned encrypted-disk capability proof ran during the baseline pass. No local Swift builds.
Per-process RSS excludes device allocations and child processes; no power or battery measurement.
No corpus audio, human reference text or model predictions redistributed.
